items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Yeah, I knew him up there.

ctx.x: He had that barrension, you see. Oh, he had a whole lot of fast fingering. Fast fingering. Fast fingering. I don't know how he was here. He was better here, because he was playing with boys.
He had one of the best read sections in Chicago, great Jimmy Noon. Yeah, I knew him up there.
